title: Mo100z [26.10] NEW SPLIT !! CHALLENGER BEL'VETH INDEPTH GUIDE UPDATED!!
author: Mo100z

Taliyah.summary: A strong Taliyah, especially on a crit build, disrupts your kit badly. Never dash inside her minefield or you will be stunned immediately. The game is still winnable, but treat her as a priority threat.

RekSai.summary: Very hard: her knockup sets up near one-shots and she deals true damage. During her ult she burrows and your E cannot damage her. From level 6 she can burst you, so avoid her knockup and play around her kill threat.

Hecarim.summary: You should beat him; only his fear really bothers you. Just make sure he does not out-farm you or out-pace your clears.

JarvanIV.summary: If he gets an early lead he can one-shot you and the game gets hard. If you survive his early pressure, you outscale him.

Ekko.summary: Whoever gets ahead first tends to win, and you also have the scaling to fall back on.

Zac.summary: He brings lots of CC; dodge it and you are fine, but it becomes very hard if you fall behind.

Maokai.summary: Lots of crowd control, so respect it and choose your fights carefully.

Gragas.summary: A good combo can one-shot you, but your many dashes make his body slam hard to land unless he Flashes.

Kindred.summary: A skill matchup. She may invade you, but you can win that one-on-one.

Rammus.summary: Out-gank him early. Wait out his W defensive stance and avoid his taunt; the crit build works well since you are not stacking attack speed into his thorns.

Jax.summary: The author considers him overtuned and a hard counter to you, and recommends banning him every game.
